content.comment_body: The English product support now offers a firmware update V2.1 for [product_name] CMR2020 ([article_no]) and [product_name] CMR2040 ([article_no]). These modules will be shipped with a new hardware version 2 and firmware V2.1 starting late January 2018, featuring new functions and product improvements. The update enhances security against potential attacks, so updating is strongly recommended. The firmware is available for free download, and existing units with FW V1.x or V2.x can be updated using Web Based Management (WBM). Key enhancements include: added support for server certificates with email and DynDNS services, deletion of all SMS messages on SIM upon CMR restart, improved handling of SMS bursts, required double confirmation for changes in operating state via WBM, resolved issues connecting to mail servers needing module certificates, fixed freezing when using Dyn DNS for IP transmission, correct transmission of DWord via SMS/email, resolution of sporadic freezing when communicating over mobile networks, improved WBM display, and accurate mobile data counters during LTE operation.
Including CA certificate support for VPN certificates would be very useful, as it is currently not possible to use them with OpenVPN on an iPhone.
The previous link is no longer functional. Where can the latest firmware update be downloaded?
There is a newer firmware update available. Please refer to this resource: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users note valuable robustness and usability improvements in the firmware update, but request broader VPN certificate support and easier access to current firmware resources. Persistent challenges include VPN interoperability with third-party apps and outdated firmware download links.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy VPN setup through integrated CA certificate support (such as OpenVPN compatibility), reliable access to firmware downloads, and seamless mobile device functioning.
